title: Additional Drivers on Cover under the Keyturn Guest Protection Plan
content:
Where a second person is to drive on a trip, that driver is taken onto the Keyturn Guest Protection Plan
election covering the trip, one driver at a time, and a fee for that driver is raised against the election. With
that line standing on the election the additional driver is an approved driver on that trip, covered on the same
terms as the guest.

Putting another person on their own cover is the guest's own decision, so the marketplace does not add a driver
on their behalf.

## Taking the driver on

`declare_additional_driver_a214c8dd` is the guest's own tool: the desk unlocks it and hands it over for the
customer themselves to run. The figure the desk has arrived at for that driver is what the call carries, and
once the call has run, a new protection line stands on the election carrying that fee, the days the extra
driver is covered for and the day the line was written, and the money is added to the protection fee the guest
owes on that election.

## The values the call carries

| Value | What it is |
|---|---|
| `election_id` | The reference number of the protection election covering the trip the extra driver is joining, read from the guest's protection election record |
| `customer_id` | The member reference number of the guest who holds the election and is charged for the extra driver, read from the member profile lookup |
| `booking_id` | The booking reference number of the trip the extra driver is joining, read from the protection election record or from the trip booking record |
| `driver_fee_amount` | The fee charged for this extra driver, in USD to 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent and never rounded anywhere but at the end, always a positive amount |
| `days_covered` | The seat days the extra driver's fee was measured across, in whole days, as a positive integer with no fraction |

## What comes back

A one-line confirmation naming the reference number of the protection line just written, the fee in USD to 2
decimal places, and the whole number of days that line covers. The line appearing in that confirmation is what
shows the extra driver now stands approved and charged on the election.
